findings.detail: In-memory values surviving Back are not a persisted draft
review-fields without acknowledgement saves unresolved classifications without marking reviewed
Reviewer submission accepts complete business draft with tax review pending; READY does not create review acknowledgement
Stale save retains selected values and does not unlock Next; no network interception used
Successful current review persists through reload and step3/back; this is not final expense confirmation

currentHelpers.limits: Synthetic helper inputs. No DB, final API confirmation, tax entitlement or new implementation is proven.

results.detail: A usable RECEIPT is routed to the normal path by the current prepare helper
ABBREVIATED_TAX_INVOICE lacks that same valid-receipt guard
Complete handwritten facts still receive a needs-substitute reason
Lost receipt exception is distinguished from having a usable receipt
Unreviewed source, unknown tax and zero amount remain genuine prerequisites
The current certificate flow is THB only: do not promise completion for unsupported currency
Unchanged saved review is current and replaced source identity invalidates it
v1 review does not bind vendor or amount changes; broader v2 source binding is required
A supporting-slot evidence set cannot satisfy current receipt-or-substitute routing
File purpose alone changes that answer even though the source remains TRANSFER_SLIP
A missing-receipt reason forces an issued certificate without an alternative-evidence route
An issued certificate requires an artifact; the label ISSUED alone is insufficient
The no-primary domain guard demands finance permission again; it cannot consume a prior alternative-evidence acceptance
The domain confirm validator itself does not require a review marker (not a claim that the complete confirm API succeeded)
Unsaved/current review uses one Next predicate; back/draft recovery must be supplied by the page
A final-page subtitle may be clear while its blocker needs a separate actionable recovery target
Existing VAT-difference recovery preserves confirmer permission and a route to set VAT first

specModel.claim: The declared spec graph has reachable save/wait/action-required checkpoints and conditional completion for three supported routes without accounting handoff. This is NOT browser/API E2E proof, durable offline storage, or a guarantee that external facts/permissions will arrive.
